complexity_review: O(n^2) time and O(n) auxiliary space: clean components are saved only if adjacent to exactly the removed infection source; all other contributions are independent of the removed source.
evidence_scope: prospective finite public-domain output/type/local-effects qualification, not universal proof
objective: Delete one initially infected vertex and all its edges; minimize final infection count, breaking ties by smallest vertex index.
official_domain: 2<=n<=300; symmetric n by n binary matrix with diagonal ones; unique initial vertices in range, 1<=len(initial)<n.
provenance: Owner-provided existing implementations, independently reviewed against official public statement; original files unchanged.
